propositions: Negative caplog assertions pass vacuously when zero records arrive, silently losing all coverage while reporting success to the test harness

Logger propagation disabled process-globally (propagate=False) or logger level raised (setLevel above INFO) renders downstream caplog assertions unreachable, with no diagnostic output distinguishing void from verified
The suite cannot determine from a green run whether caplog assertions in negative form actually verified behavior or passed due to void input
Five identified negative caplog assertions across the codebase are at risk when logger state leaks between tests without restoration
An autouse fixture guarding propagation state at test setup/teardown makes unreachable assertions fail loudly at the source and contain level mutations per-test to prevent cascade
